lines.text: Terrarium One. It began as a laboratory containing ecosystems. It became an ecosystem containing laboratories.
Handler. Welcome to the Common. Your certification is still warm, so I'll keep this simple.
Six hours ago the seismographs on our Red Reaches Gate started singing. Something is shaking the foundations of the Ochre Span.
A Spanwright crossing. Older than anyone's records. Built in the same tradition as the Red Span.
The tradition that failed.
Translation: he's going. He decided before you walked in. I saw that one without even trying.
There's a licensed extraction operation in the valley. Thoughtstone prospecting. The permit is Dominion-backed.
The signature on the permit is Dexter Mane's. His decisions are loud. Very sharp branches.
Dexter does nothing by accident. That's the problem.

choice.text: Aruun, I'd be glad to have you with me.
Why does one bridge matter this much?
Cigarra — can you see how this goes?

lines.text: Glad isn't required. Careful is.
In the Reaches, strength means the burden you can accept without forcing it onto someone weaker.
A bridge is that idea, in stone. When it fails, it fails on the people who trusted it.
No. And if I could, I wouldn't tell you. A future seen is a future touched.
Ask me what's likely. That's cheaper. For both of us.
Ground rules. These two are partners, not equipment. You don't order them. You ask, and you'd better be right.
Dangerous wildlife can come home under Wild Containment. Anything that might be a person — you scan, you talk, you leave it be.
She means me. She always means me.
I mean everyone, Cigarra.
The Gate is tuned to the Red Reaches. First descents hit hard — we call it the Tilt. Breathe through it.
Tap the GATE when you're ready to descend.
